items.title: Gordon Lorraine — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He used to come to our apartment on Grove Street... He cooked for us... Sidney was... I knew all his wives... They had such a rapport of love and music. Sidney was... I loved him.

ctx.x: And he was in the Army when you got married.

Yes. Well, that’s what did it, so I could say I was a war bride. And we weren’t ready to get married prior to that. We were just enjoying each other, listening to jazz. That’s all we did. And he was recording people. Sidney Bechet! I mean, I met Sidney Bechet through Alfred, who was Alfred’s good friend. Alfred adored him. I adored him. All the women adored Sidney. He was a beautiful, wonderful guy, in spite of what other people say... I’ve read some things. But yeah...so...yeah... He got drafted into the Army,…
